newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIA'S BNI SAYS H1 NET UP 57.39 PCT.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIA'S BNI SAYS H1 NET UP 57.39 PCT.

text.p: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) said on Thursday it posted a net profit of 230.1 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1997, up 57.39 percent from the same period last year.

BNI, Indonesia's largest bank, said in a statement that pre-tax profit increased by 61.38 percent to 320.5 billion rupiah in the period while first-half operating income was up 15.47 percent to 2.496 trillion rupiah.
Interest income increased 18.93 percent to 2.265 trillion rupiah, it said.
Operating expenses, mostly interest expenses, increased 8.32 percent to 1.623 trillion rupiah, it said.
The net interest margin increased to 3.74 percent at the end of June 1997 against 2.65 percent a year previously, BNI said.
The cost to income ratio fell to 52.22 percent in June 1997 from 54.30 percent the previous year, it said.
